steps.text: DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal, on Highball 0.9.19 or later (its engines carry the corrected DirectX 12 shim, without it the game reports "Failed to initialize DirectX 12", highball-db#48). Never add -dx11, the game crashes at start with two graphics API flags. AVX is advertised to the game because it was on in the working run; whether it is needed is not known.

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" a few seconds after launch on D3DMetal, no crash, no log (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: measured: the DirectX 12 timestamp shim exported its functions numbered from 1 and the game binds D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.9.19 and its engines r3 and r9. Confirmed by the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at second zero at fixed addresses when -dx11 is among the Steam launch options
knownIssues.cause: measured from the crash context: the game adds its own DirectX 12 flag and Unreal refuses two graphics API flags
